elements: TokenEngine | machine.ts | instance schema + active[] (current = first-token alias), fire-edge/activate/join ops, per-state attempts
PacketService | loop.ts | next() with per-session state assignment, submit routed by state, evidence validation + collision-free pinning
RunService | run.ts + runs store (new file) | background spawn, handle record, completion signal, pinned run_ref
Adjudication | gate.ts | offer QUEUE (state-keyed array), dismiss/supersede/replace ops, grant + advance unchanged
LawGuards | toll.ts + dispatch | commit-window state, test-lane scope check, update-on-submit, boot-project refusal
Record | calllog.ts + notes + emit | clause on failure, one line per dispatch, generic aggregation query, drained marks, last_verify by timestamp
Surface | bin/se-board.ts | branch columns from canvas geometry, token highlights, iteration tabs (later), process lane endpoints
HotReload | bin/se-mcp.ts shim | mtime-keyed dynamic import of the engine per call (dev mode)
payload.allocation_dmm: 8 function clusters x 8 homes, 1:1 except SESSION ASSIGNMENT which rides PacketService (thin, no own state). No cluster homeless, no home clusterless.
interfaces: instance JSON | TokenEngine <-> PacketService <-> Adjudication | single source of iteration truth
offer queue file | Adjudication -> Surface + watchers | replaces the single-offer file, same location
runs store file | RunService -> PacketService + Surface | handles and completions, machine-local
calls.jsonl | Record -> Surface + retro queries | append-only
canvas files | compiler -> TokenEngine | pinned version, refuse-loud
payload.structure_note: Coupling stays acyclic: Surface reads everything, writes nothing; LawGuards sit on dispatch only; the instance remains the only mutable truth for iteration state.
